description: This file exports various modules, types, and functions related to cryptographic operations in a Matrix SDK, including bootstrap, facade, decryption bridge, persistence, verification, and status.

classes.name: MatrixVerificationManager
classes.description: A class managing verification processes for devices or sessions.
